claims.quote: According to the latest combined data from NOAA and NASA, the global surface temperature in 2024 ranked highest in the 145-year record at 1.54°C (2.77°F) above the early industrial (1881-1910) baseline average.

claims.claim: This made 2024 the hottest year on record since systematic temperature measurements began in 1880.
NASA Notably, this was the first time that an annual global average temperature anomaly exceeded 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels, marking a significant milestone in climate records.
